episodes.title: V.I.P. (V.I.P.)
episodes.summary: On the eve of Germany's World Cup qualifier, off-duty cop Grimmer spots police nearby at a fresh crime scene and is shocked to see who the victim is.

episodes.title: Mannschaft (Team)
episodes.summary: Grimmer's neo-Nazi links spur a search for a case partner of Turkish descent. Grimmer's wife suffers a trauma that puts her kids in questionable care.

episodes.title: Begegnung (Clash)
episodes.summary: A Tariq-Amir member set on stealing the clan's throne makes a gruesome bet on the match to secure an ally. Erol ensures the clan sees him with Murad.

episodes.title: Heimspiel (Home Game)
episodes.summary: A second murder sends Grimmer scrambling to cover his tracks. Bou'Penga hides from the world and visits a lair that his late teammate took him to once.

episodes.title: Schiebung (Foul Play)
episodes.summary: A reporter presses Erol for dirt on Grimmer. Kareem blackmails Bou'Penga. Grimmer talks his way into leading a raid of Kovac's betting shops.

episodes.title: Abseits (Offside)
episodes.summary: Murad gets his chance onstage. Blackmailed Bou'Penga plays against Leipzig. Kareem turns Hakim against Kovac. A jealous Bine sneaks into Grimmer's home.

episodes.title: Derby (Derby)
episodes.summary: The police search for Erdem's Lamborghini. Bou'Penga makes Kareem an offer. Erol ventures into the no-cops zone. Trinity tracks down Schmaus in Chile.

episodes.title: Länderspiel (National)
episodes.summary: Conflicting clans show up for Erdem's funeral, as do the cops, who are looking for a new lead. Erol receives a horrifying message. Bine finds a job.

episodes.title: Verlängerung (Overtime)
episodes.summary: Erdem's killer is revealed. Trinity breaks into Laubach's home to look for evidence confirming Schmaus's claims. Murad confesses a lie to his sister.

episodes.title: Siegerehrung (Victory Ceremony)
episodes.summary: A tip on the location of Hakim's cache of contraband spurs Grimmer and Erol to use shady tactics to get authorization for a raid in the no-cops zone.
